import os
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Locate the full-height divider and the non-background object on its right.
    bg=grid[0][0]
    div=next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c]==2 for r in range(h)))
    obj=[(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(div+1,w) if grid[r][c]!=bg]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,c,v in obj: out[r][c]=bg
    # Mirror the object across the divider into the adjacent area.
    for r,c,v in obj:
        nc=2*div+1-c
        if 0<=nc<w: out[r][nc]=v
    # Mark the outside edge of the reflected object with color 8.
    # The marker runs the full height.
    edge=div+1+max((div-c for _,c,_ in obj),default=0)
    if 0<=edge<w:
        for r in range(h): out[r][edge]=8
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)

code='''def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    bg=grid[0][0]
    div=next(c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c]==2 for r in range(h)))
    obj=[(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(div+1,w) if grid[r][c]!=bg]
    out=[row[:] for row in grid]
    for r,c,v in obj: out[r][c]=bg
    left=min(c for _,c,_ in obj)
    for r,c,v in obj:
        nc=div+1+(c-left)
        if nc<w: out[r][nc]=v
    edge=div+1+(max(c for _,c,_ in obj)-left+1)
    if edge<w:
        for r in range(h): out[r][edge]=8
    return out
'''
